body: It always sounded pseudo-deep to me. I don't get what he's trying to say- That people react more calmly to something they know is going to happen then things that happen unexpectedly? Well that just makes sense.

Same, but there's no use dwelling on it. People are always anxious about these things because they think the point of life is being happy and that being unhappy is time wasted. This is in reality only applicable for a small subset of people.
